games.content_enrichment_source: Steam Store Browse + appdetails + public Store tags
games.short_description_en: Hike through the worst forest full of the most horrible trees. Do not trust them. The trees will trick you. They will bully you. They will hurt you. If only you could find an axe...

games.name: Dawn of Defense
games.short_description: 戰爭的號角迴盪在風中，氏族的戰火再度灼燒世界！在《軍團塔防》點燃RTS與塔防的雙線烽火，集結鋼鐵軍團於險峻高地，帶領部落殺入血色裂谷迎擊敵潮。以古老魔法構築堅不可摧的戰爭工事，鍛造屬於你的戰爭法則。踏入這場榮耀與破曉的血色試煉！
games.short_description_en: Dawn of Defense blends RTS, Tower Defense, and Roguelite progression. In a last defense, lead your tribe against the Empire: Command warriors in battle, fortify defenses, and build an economy as you fight to reclaim your ancestral homeland.

games.name: Burning Sword: Death Sun
games.short_description: 《Burning Sword: Death Sun》是一款以 12 世紀中國為舞臺的武俠動作遊戲。扮演被北山長老打落的張逸羨，殺出一條血路重返仇人面前。硬派戰鬥、史詩頭目戰、類 Roguelite 成長，以及專為刷分而設的競技場。
games.short_description_en: Burning Sword: Death Sun is a wuxia action game set in 12th century China. Play as Zhang Yixiang, cast down by the Elder of the Northern Mountain, and carve a bloody path back to him. Hardcore combat, epic boss battles, roguelite progression, and an arena built for high scores.

games.name: Flick
games.short_description: 只需輕輕一撥開關，現實就在你眼前翻轉，把你拽入光怪陸離的世界，去揭開家族扭曲的過往。在這款心理恐怖遊戲中，前進離不開光，光卻也會召喚出最駭人的夢魘，你必須在兩者之間小心拿捏。
games.short_description_en: Flick light switches on and off throughout a long-abandoned house to shift the environment from a safe reality to a blood-soaked echo where grisly puzzles manifest. A psychological horror experience where you must balance the light you need to progress with the terrifying nightmares it summons.

games.name: Arkheron
games.short_description: 每次挑戰截然不同，新戰利品、新敵人、新策略、新記憶。《Arkheron》是一款快節奏的俯視團隊 PvP 遊戲，戰鬥途中取得的物品都會改變你的玩法。帶上兩個好友一起爬上高塔，發揮出人意料的策略，奮力殺進下一層。
games.short_description_en: No two runs are ever the same. New loot, new enemies, new strategies, new memories. Arkheron is a fast-paced, isometric PvP where every item you grab rewrites how you play mid-fight. Take two friends up the Tower, pull off strats that shouldn’t work, and fight your way to the next floor.

games.name: Our Life: Now & Forever
games.short_description: A paper airplane, two new neighbors, four autumns, and a one of a kind life. Create an experience that’s all your own in this near-fully customizable, choice-heavy story where you grow from childhood to adulthood.

games.name: Reshine
games.short_description: 輕輕清掉老舊物品上的灰塵、鏽斑和歲月痕跡，細心修復它們。在 Reshine 中享受極簡的放鬆體驗：使用各種工具，看著經年累月的汙垢在眼前消失。不必管理、沒有壓力 — 你可以自己在這裡好好享受讓復古珍寶重獲光彩的滿足感。
games.short_description_en: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.

games.name: Am I Nima
games.short_description: 在《Am I Nima》這款心理恐怖遊戲中，你必須設法說服媽媽，讓她相信你確實是她的女兒。你要組合各種詞彙來和媽媽對話，以取得她的信任。

games.short_description_en: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.
